scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of a housing loan application I submitted recently. Can you tell me if there's any update?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, loan ID LOAN-01878, has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh, wow. I wasn't expecting that. Can you tell me why my application was denied?
dialogue.agent: Your application was denied for the following reasons: Other, Credit history, and Debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: That's frustrating to hear. I thought my credit history was in good shape, and I was under the impression my debt-to-income ratio was acceptable. Could you elaborate on what "Other" entails in this context?
dialogue.agent: I can confirm that your debt-to-income ratio was a factor in the denial. The Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. Your ratio was indicated as >60%. The record does not provide further detail on the "Other" denial reason.

dialogue.user: >60%? That seems surprisingly high. I was really counting on this loan for a home improvement project. Since the loan is denied, I'd like to know if it has been transferred or sold to another institution.
dialogue.agent: This loan was not sold to another institution. The Purchaser Type is listed as Not applicable.

dialogue.user: Okay, thank you for clarifying that. Given the denial, I'm curious about the loan terms I would have been offered if it had been approved. What would the interest rate and total costs have been for this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate and total loan costs are not available as the application was denied.

dialogue.user: <Dissatisfied> I'm really disappointed with this outcome and the lack of clear information. I was hoping to get a better understanding of my financial options, but it feels like I've hit a dead end with this application and the details provided.
